title: Generalising a Theorem of Lichtman
summary: We show that under a suitable additional hypothesis the restricted Zassenhaus $\F_p$-Lie algebra or the rational Magnus Lie algebra of a free amalgamated product is the free amalgamated product of the corresponding Lie algebras of the factors. This generalises a Theorem of A.I.\,Lichtman, who proved the analoguous statement for free products. Our conditions include the case when the amalgamated product is a retract in both factors.
